title: Permutation transporting equal-cardinality subsets
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $A$ and $B$ be subsets of the $n$ indices with equal cardinality. The transport permutation is the permutation obtained by extending a bijection from $A$ to $B$ to the full set of indices.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are subsets of the $n$ indices
caveat: The definition chooses a bijection noncomputably, so its precise choice is unspecified; the prose describes the construction but not which extension is selected.
